notes:
OFFICIAL THRESHOLD TIMELINE (all grade A, read 2026-11-05 on gov.il): the Tax Authority FAQ (published 11.09.2023, updated 27.05.2026) https://www.gov.il/he/pages/faq_israel_invoice states: 2024 = 25,000; 2025 = 20,000; from 1.1.2026 = 10,000; from 1.6.2026 = 5,000 (NIS before VAT, invoice to a licensed dealer with non-zero VAT, as a condition for deducting input VAT). The service page https://www.gov.il/he/service/request-assignment-number-for-tax-invoice says the same and "updated for 2026: above 5,000". The user-supplied timeline is therefore right except the first step: the model began 1.1.2024 and the deduction condition effectively started 5.5.2024 because invoices dated 1.1-4.5.2024 were recognised without a number (FAQ Q22). The July-2024 API document printed a slower statutory path (15,000 for 2026, 10,000 for 2027, 5,000 for 2028); the official pages now show it was accelerated. Hyp (vendor guide, 2026-08-06) says a full cancellation of the amount threshold is being promoted subject to legislation - unverified vendor statement. OFFICIAL LIST OF CONNECTED SOFTWARE: none found. The Tax Authority publishes the API services page https://www.gov.il/he/pages/apinew (updated 14.10.2026; service "מספרי הקצאה לחשבוניות" and "החזרת סכום מינימום להקצאת חשבונית" that returns the minimum amount by invoice date), the software-house connection page https://www.gov.il/he/service/connect-to-shaam and a developer portal with sandbox https://openapi-portal.taxes.gov.il/sandbox/support ; but no list of software houses that completed the interface. The nearest official register is the lookup "מרשם תוכנות לניהול מערכת חשבונות ממוחשבת" https://www.gov.il/he/service/itc-software-registry-for-computerized-accounting-systems (registration certificates for accounting software, searchable at secapp.taxes.gov.il/mm-find-tochna/main/rashi, which rendered blank in our browser) - it certifies registration, not allocation-API integration. Hence on_tax_authority_list is null on every row. DEVELOPER DOCUMENTATION: API description v2.0 (July 2024) https://www.gov.il/BlobFolder/generalpage/hor-software-other/he/vat_software-houses-180724.pdf (Approval/MultiApproval v2, sandbox https://ita-api.taxes.gov.il/shaam/tsandbox/Invoices/v2/Approval and production .../production/Invoices/v2/Approval); portal user guide https://secapp.taxes.gov.il/OpenApiUserGuide/OpenApiUserGuide.pdf ; FAQ Q15 sends sandbox registration to the software-maker document. MANUAL ROUTE: free online request for businesses using paper books or unconnected software: https://www.gov.il/he/service/request-assignment-number-for-tax-invoice ; FAQ Q22 also allows intermediary ("תווך") companies acting with the business authorization (Chamber table lists Ness Technologies, Almog Software Industries, Soft-Talk as of 2023-12). MARKET NOTES: the ISA register of financial-information (open-banking) licensees https://www.new.isa.gov.il/nav-index/supervised-api/informationapi lists invoicing vendors Green Invoice, iCount and SUMIT - a licence unrelated to allocation numbers but a useful official existence check. Foreign ERP vendors (SAP, Oracle, Odoo) are not rows because no vendor evidence was opened; see rejected. ROW COUNT: 17 rows, below the 25 target - the search tool budget ran out mid-session and many vendor sites blocked or reset our fetcher; the rejected list says what was tried. Prices: vendor pages read 2026-11-05, in NIS, mostly before VAT, promotional and annual-billing figures are marked.

Top-up 2026-11-05: Searches used: 18 of the shared 35 (including 1 for the government-services file). Sources were fetched with WebFetch, curl against the wordpress.org plugin API, and the built-in browser (Chamber of Commerce and Linet pages needed a browser). The Comax guide is an image-heavy PDF whose text layer was read locally with macOS PDFKit. Result: 9 new rows (5 Israeli vendors: Comax, Invoice Maven, Popay POS, CAV Systems, Slate; 4 foreign ERPs with Israeli localisation: SAP Business One, NetSuite, Oracle Fusion, Infor LN, all flagged foreign) so the file would reach 26 rows. Prices: only Invoice Maven (35 NIS/month before VAT, page undated) and Slate (free) have public prices; Comax, Popay, CAV and the foreign ERPs have none on the pages read. Also: a dated Rivhit Online price list (update, not a new row). Thresholds quoted inside vendor pages are the 2024 figures and are outdated; the official timeline is in the existing file. gov.il/Tax Authority: no official list of connected software exists (see the existing file's notes), so on_tax_authority_list stays null.

timeline.note: Model live; 2024 threshold 25,000; in 2024 every request is approved automatically (FAQ Q1/Q2). Same figure in the Tax Authority letter of 11.9.2023: https://www.gov.il/BlobFolder/policy/procedures-110923-2/he/vat_procedures-110923-2.pdf

FAQ Q22: because of the war, invoices dated 1.1.2024-4.5.2024 are recognised as input VAT even without an allocation number, so the number is a deduction condition from 5.5.2024. Hyp guide of 2026-08-06 and an Apideck page also print 5 May 2024 (vendor/third-party).

Official service page and FAQ Q1/Q2. Accelerated: the Tax Authority API document of July 2024 still printed 15,000 for 2026, 10,000 for 2027 and 5,000 for 2028: https://www.gov.il/BlobFolder/generalpage/hor-software-other/he/vat_software-houses-180724.pdf
Official service page: "מעל 5,000 ש"ח לפני מע"מ (מעודכן לשנת 2026)"; FAQ Q1/Q2 give 1.6.2026. Vendor guides (Hyp 2026-08-06, Base CRM) repeat it.
